parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of small decimals being rendered in exponential notation by checking if the number is smaller than the specified decimal positions and returning a string of zeros instead. The change is minimal and maintains readability.

issues.description: The patch introduces an additional condition and variable assignments, which slightly increases the complexity of the function.
